build_graph_from_image: build an adjacency graph from a 2D image using pixel-to-pixel gradient connections
create_patches_from_image: create a collection of 2D patches extracted from an image with specified patch size
reconstruct_image_from_patches: reconstruct a 2D image from its patches by averaging overlapping regions
build_grid_connectivity_graph: build a grid connectivity graph with optional mask and custom dimensions
extract_patches_with_transformer: extract patches from multiple images using PatchExtractor transformer API
